sections.title: In 1.0 and 1.1
sections.intro: What you can build on today, grouped. Each line has its page in the docs and its decision record in the repository.

items.title: Bazel 8.8 and 9.x, tested
items.text: Both in CI, with the rulesets at their lowest and their newest versions.

items.title: Committed bindings, guarded (ADR-064)
items.text: undra_bindings_test fails on drift and names the one command that updates.

items.title: The NDK as a declared input (ADR-065)
items.text: No cargo-ndk anywhere; Android built in CI; the action is cacheable.

items.title: Lint exclusions by choice
items.text: Beside the trees, or none, for a repository that lints everything.

items.title: Symbol files and the debugger
items.text: undra symbolicate on a Bazel build; a breakpoint in a Rust frame from a rules_apple app.

items.title: A leaderboard of 100,000 rows
items.text: The high-frequency recipe: ingest off the lock, publish a window, measured.

items.title: React Native 0.86
items.text: Verified on the simulator and the emulator, the module unchanged.

items.title: Records, enums and typed errors
items.text: From one schema, written as each language writes them.

items.title: Stores, signals and computeds
items.text: Reactive state in the core; one change-set per transaction.

items.title: Keyed and derived lists (ADR-039)
items.text: A filtered view of 10,000 rows sends 158 bytes for one edit, not 353 KB.

items.title: Objects and host callbacks (ADR-040, ADR-041)
items.text: Classes cross as themselves; the core calls back through typed interfaces.

items.title: Newtypes, Decimal, generic types (ADR-042)
items.text: Read as native types on every platform.

items.title: Generic functions, objects and stores (ADR-058)
items.text: Declared instantiations arrive as overloads and ordinary classes.

items.title: One error channel (ADR-032)
items.text: Calls fail with a typed error; generated Swift never traps.

items.title: Several cores in one app (ADR-044)
items.text: Each core is self-contained, storage included.

items.title: SwiftUI, Compose and React
items.text: Plus Vue, Svelte and Solid adapters for the web runtime.

items.title: React Native (ADR-038)
items.text: A TurboModule over the C ABI under the same TypeScript mirror.

items.title: iOS 15 and 16 (ADR-045)
items.text: ObservableObject stores below iOS 17; proven by compilation and a probe on iOS 26.5.

items.title: No manual build step
items.text: A Gradle task, an Xcode build phase and a Vite plugin run undra build.

items.title: Bazel rules (ADR-061)
items.text: undra_core and undra_bindings, hermetic and offline; JVM, Node and Swift tested.

items.title: Everything from GitHub at one tag (ADR-063)
items.text: The crates, the Swift package, the Kotlin modules (JitPack) and the npm runtimes; no account needed.

items.title: Queries and mutations
items.text: Staleness, dedup, retry and optimistic updates with rollback.

items.title: Offline queue and persistence
items.text: Queued writes replay on reconnect and survive a restart.

items.title: Paged and lazy lists, polling (ADR-043)
items.text: A lazy list pages 10,000 rows on demand; polling pauses with the app.

items.title: Migrations and typed storage (ADR-037, ADR-049)
items.text: A changed schema still restores what the last version stored.

items.title: Snapshot, restore and web recovery
items.text: A crashed web core restarts from its last snapshot.

items.title: Ten ports, with adapters and fakes
items.text: Http, Kv, SecureStore, Fs, Clock, Rng, Log, Timer, Connectivity, Lifecycle.

items.title: WebSocket, SSE and Db (ADR-047, ADR-048)
items.text: Streams with backpressure, and SQL over SQLite, each with a deterministic fake.

items.title: Your own network stack (ADR-060)
items.text: OkHttp, URLSession and fetch as the app configured them.

items.title: Android adapters
items.text: Backed by the platform, installed with one call.

items.title: State-preserving reload (ADR-053, ADR-059)
items.text: undra dev rebuilds on save and keeps the state and query handles.

items.title: Devtools (ADR-054)
items.text: Live stores, a change-set timeline with time travel, port and query logs.

items.title: undra schema diff (ADR-062)
items.text: Each API change marked breaking or additive, for review and CI.

items.title: init, doctor and upgrade
items.text: A project with CI, every missing tool with its fix, pins moved in one step.

items.title: Teaching diagnostics
items.text: Every macro error says what, why and how to fix it.

items.title: Reconnect everywhere (ADR-051)
items.text: Apps on all three platforms reconnect to undra dev by themselves.

items.title: A testing kit for apps (ADR-055)
items.text: Previews on the real core; recorded sessions replay in tests.

items.title: The contract grid
items.text: The same scenarios against the real core on Swift, Kotlin and TypeScript, every cell passing.

items.title: Adversarial reviews
items.text: Every core crate and every feature, reviewed by someone who did not write it.

items.title: The JavaScript runtime at 16 KB (ADR-057)
items.text: What a page loads up front went from 22.1 KB to 15.8 KB gzipped.

items.title: The web core under 120 KB (ADR-052)
items.text: The hello-world wasm, measured and gated in CI.

items.title: Native size profile and gates (ADR-052)
items.text: Release builds tuned for size; opt_level chooses smaller or faster.

items.title: The web call path (ADR-056)
items.text: A generated TypeScript call went from 3.2–3.5 µs to 0.47–0.68 µs.

items.title: Frame-coalesced delivery (ADR-031)
items.text: Each mirror applies what arrived once per frame.

items.title: Harsh-conditions benchmarks
items.text: Firehose, churn, fan-out, backpressure and a soak, with CI gates.

items.title: Panic reports and symbols (ADR-046)
items.text: A contained panic reaches the app with frames undra symbolicate reads.

items.title: Background runs (ADR-046)
items.text: The offline queue drains under the OS's deadline.

items.title: A runtime ends when its owner lets go (ADR-034)
items.text: Off-core writes are refused; a panicking computed poisons only itself.

items.title: Cookbook and migration guides
items.text: Recipes, and the way over from Kotlin Multiplatform and UniFFI.

items.title: Fieldbook
items.text: A production-shaped sample beyond the playground.

items.title: API reference
items.text: Swift, Kotlin and TypeScript from the generated code; Rust from rustdoc.

sections.title: Planned next
sections.intro: Each of these is recorded as open in the repository, with the work done around it. A plan, not a promise; the order may change.

items.title: Benchmarks on physical phones
items.text: Every device row so far is from a simulator, an emulator or headless Chromium. Real-phone rows next, then budgets for them and a CI job.
items.source: .10x/status.md checkpoint 34, the open list; bench/RESULTS.md, Pending hardware

items.title: Maven Central and the npm registry
items.text: The conventional registries, after launch, beside GitHub: the Kotlin runtime on Maven Central and the npm packages on the registry. undra upgrade moves a project over. crates.io follows, under a registry-safe prefix.

items.title: Homebrew (brew install undra)
items.text: Through homebrew-core, once the repository is 30 days old and notable (75 stars, or 30 forks or watchers). There is no tap at launch: the installer and cargo are the two ways to get the CLI.
items.source: .10x/adrs/ADR-063-launch-distribution-from-github.md, Amendment: no Homebrew tap at launch (2026-10-03)

items.title: Android modules tested in CI
items.text: undra-compose, android-adapters and android-work pass locally and on the emulator; an emulator job in CI runs them.
items.source: .10x/status.md checkpoint 34 (on hold until the founder says go); .10x/handoff.md

items.title: Android under Bazel, verified
items.text: The rules declare Android; a build and a test run prove it.

items.title: Byte-reproducible undra build
items.text: Today the same core built in two directories differs, because cargo hashes the absolute path into crate names.

items.title: The examples on schema diff
items.text: Commit each example's schema.json, so the repository reviews its own API changes the way it asks apps to.

items.title: Cancelled port calls reach the platform
items.text: A cancelled call is abandoned in the core today while the platform's request runs on. Its own decision record first.

items.title: Your network stack, proved further
items.text: Certificate pinning through OkHttp end to end, a build against OkHttp 5, and the iOS WebSocket adapter refusing a background session as the SSE adapter does.

items.title: Smaller Android libraries
items.text: Relocation packing saves about 3%, once a load test on API 23 passes.

items.title: Windows CLI
items.text: Release binaries and docs for the undra command on Windows.

items.title: A custom domain
items.text: A home for the site and docs that is the project's own.

sections.title: Later
sections.intro: Decided in direction and waiting their turn.

items.title: Dart and Flutter bindings
items.text: A fourth host after React Native, which proved the pattern. Not started.

items.title: Desktop as a first-class target
items.text: Compose Desktop and macOS samples built in CI over the runtimes that exist; Windows and Linux over the same C ABI.

items.title: Xcode 27
items.text: The Swift test target was reported not to build on Xcode 27. Our machines and CI run Xcode 26; it is fixed once it reproduces.
items.source: .10x/status.md checkpoint 34 (U2, not taken on: needs the crash log)

sections.title: Exploring
sections.intro: Questions the project is asking, not plans.

items.title: A GraphQL story
items.text: Undra has no GraphQL layer; an app built around Apollo keeps Apollo on the platform side.

items.title: A sync engine
items.text: If it comes, a separate package, not part of the core.

items.title: Compose Multiplatform interop
items.text: An Undra core under a Compose Multiplatform UI.

notPlanned.title: Not planned
notPlanned.text: Shared UI of any kind, and hosted services. Undra owns everything under the pixels and leaves the screens to SwiftUI, Compose, React and React Native.
